extends CharacterBody3D
## The robot. World-axis movement (move_forward = -Z), jump, facing follows motion.
## Telemetry is opt-in and read-only: this node is in group mcp_watch and implements _mcp_state().

signal died(cause: String)

const SPEED := 4.0
const ACCEL := 30.0
const JUMP_VELOCITY := 5.4
const GRAVITY := 16.0
const TURN_SPEED := 10.0

@onready var visual: Node3D = $Visual

var facing_yaw_deg := 0.0
var zone := "spawn"
var alive := true
var controls_enabled := true
var ticks := 0
var run_ticks := 0
var jumps := 0
var checkpoints: Array = []
var last_input := Vector2.ZERO
var spawn: Vector3 = ArenaLayout.SPAWN


func reset_to_spawn() -> void:
	global_position = spawn
	velocity = Vector3.ZERO
	alive = true
	controls_enabled = true
	run_ticks = 0
	jumps = 0
	checkpoints.clear()
	zone = "spawn"
	facing_yaw_deg = 0.0
	visual.rotation.y = 0.0


func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	ticks += 1
	if alive:
		run_ticks += 1
	var input := Vector2.ZERO
	if controls_enabled and alive:
		input = Input.get_vector("move_left", "move_right", "move_forward", "move_back")
	last_input = input
	var wish := Vector3(input.x, 0.0, input.y) * SPEED
	velocity.x = move_toward(velocity.x, wish.x, ACCEL * delta)
	velocity.z = move_toward(velocity.z, wish.z, ACCEL * delta)
	if is_on_floor():
		if controls_enabled and alive and Input.is_action_just_pressed("jump"):
			velocity.y = JUMP_VELOCITY
			jumps += 1
			get_tree().call_group("bn_bridge", "record_event", "jump", {"z": snappedf(global_position.z, 0.01)})
			get_tree().call_group("music", "play_sfx", "jump")
	else:
		velocity.y -= GRAVITY * delta
	move_and_slide()
	var h := Vector2(velocity.x, velocity.z)
	if h.length() > 0.2:
		var target_yaw := atan2(-velocity.x, -velocity.z)
		visual.rotation.y = lerp_angle(visual.rotation.y, target_yaw, TURN_SPEED * delta)
	facing_yaw_deg = rad_to_deg(visual.rotation.y)
	visual.position.y = 0.04 * sin(ticks * 0.12)
	_update_zone()
	if alive and global_position.y < ArenaLayout.DEATH_Y:
		die("fell")


func _update_zone() -> void:
	var z := ArenaLayout.zone_at(global_position.z)
	if z != zone:
		zone = z
		if alive and z != "void" and not checkpoints.has(z):
			checkpoints.append(z)
			get_tree().call_group("bn_bridge", "record_event", "zone_entered", {"zone": z, "run_ticks": run_ticks})


func die(cause: String) -> void:
	if not alive:
		return
	alive = false
	controls_enabled = false
	died.emit(cause)


func _mcp_state() -> Dictionary:
	return {
		"position": [snappedf(global_position.x, 0.001), snappedf(global_position.y, 0.001), snappedf(global_position.z, 0.001)],
		"velocity": [snappedf(velocity.x, 0.001), snappedf(velocity.y, 0.001), snappedf(velocity.z, 0.001)],
		"on_floor": is_on_floor(),
		"facing_yaw_deg": snappedf(facing_yaw_deg, 0.1),
		"zone": zone,
		"alive": alive,
		"run_ticks": run_ticks,
		"jumps": jumps,
		"input": [last_input.x, last_input.y],
		"checkpoints": checkpoints.duplicate(),
	}

extends Node3D
## Builds the static arena from ArenaLayout at runtime: one StaticBody3D per block with a BoxShape3D and a BoxMesh.
## Solid blocks live on physics layer 1 (world). Decorative strips have no collision.

const COLORS := {
	"floor": Color(0.2, 0.21, 0.25), "platform": Color(0.14, 0.2, 0.2), "bridge": Color(0.2, 0.16, 0.14),
	"wall": Color(0.16, 0.18, 0.24), "obstacle": Color(0.32, 0.24, 0.12), "hurdle": Color(0.5, 0.45, 0.1),
}

func _ready() -> void:
	for b in ArenaLayout.BLOCKS:
		_add_block(b)
	for l in ArenaLayout.LIGHTS:
		var light := OmniLight3D.new()
		light.position = l["pos"]
		light.light_color = l["color"]
		light.light_energy = l["energy"]
		light.omni_range = l["range"]
		light.shadow_enabled = false
		add_child(light)


func _add_block(b: Dictionary) -> void:
	var kind: String = b["kind"]
	var size: Vector3 = b["size"]
	var mesh := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var box := BoxMesh.new()
	box.size = size
	mesh.mesh = box
	var mat := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	if kind == "strip" or kind == "strip_warn":
		mat.emission_enabled = true
		mat.emission = Color(0.3, 0.8, 1.0) if kind == "strip" else Color(1.0, 0.3, 0.2)
		mat.emission_energy_multiplier = 3.0
		mat.albedo_color = Color.BLACK
		mesh.material_override = mat
		mesh.name = b["name"]
		mesh.position = b["pos"]
		add_child(mesh)
		return
	mat.albedo_color = COLORS.get(kind, Color(0.2, 0.2, 0.2))
	mat.metallic = 0.35
	mat.roughness = 0.6
	if kind == "hurdle":
		mat.emission_enabled = true
		mat.emission = Color(1.0, 0.85, 0.2)
		mat.emission_energy_multiplier = 0.6
	mesh.material_override = mat
	mesh.name = "Mesh"
	var body := StaticBody3D.new()
	body.name = b["name"]
	body.position = b["pos"]
	body.collision_layer = int(b.get("layer", 1))
	body.collision_mask = 0
	var shape := CollisionShape3D.new()
	shape.name = "Shape"
	var bs := BoxShape3D.new()
	bs.size = size
	shape.shape = bs
	shape.disabled = kind == "hurdle"
	body.add_child(shape)
	body.add_child(mesh)
	body.add_to_group("arena_block")
	add_child(body)
